verdict.rationale: The evidence shows one-shot agent tasks ('start tasks with a single API call') and HyperAgent's natural-language page.ai()/page.extract() calls inside Playwright scripts. Nothing documents a first-party workflow composer with loops, conditionals, or parameterized steps. Any control flow would come from the developer's own JavaScript code, which is a building block rather than the product's capability.

support.subject: As an automation-engineer, I can compose repeatable multi-step workflows with loops, conditionals, and parameters instead of one-shot prompts
